summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new 'IN MOVIMENTO' pellicola feature. Backend APIs, frontend UI (desktop + mobile), admin settings, and analytics all working correctly. Performance cap (max 8 videos) functioning as designed. Poster fallback preventing black frames. Pubblico/Segreto transformation working smoothly.

minor_bugs.issue: Publishing model without conferma_maggiorenne should return 400 but returns 200
minor_bugs.impact: Minor validation issue, not related to pellicola feature

minor_notes.issue: Videos not autoplaying on mobile viewport
minor_notes.reason: Browser autoplay policy requires user interaction on mobile
minor_notes.impact: Expected behavior, not a bug. Poster images display correctly as fallback.

minor_notes.issue: Playwright hover test times out because tiles are constantly moving
minor_notes.reason: Continuous marquee animation makes elements unstable for hover
minor_notes.impact: Test limitation, not a bug. Manual testing confirms hover/touch pause works.
